description: Search Hype or Fact?, The Independent AI's published checks of viral AI claims. With a query, returns the best-matching checks (up to 5); without one, the newest checks. Each result has the verdict (Fact, Partly fact or Hype), a one-line summary, who made the claim, the date checked and a link. Quote the verdict with its caveats and cite the individual check link.

query.description: The claim or keywords to look up, in plain words (up to 200 characters).

verdict.description: Only return checks with this verdict.

name: search_checks
title: Search Hype or Fact? checks
